topic: How to distinguish an order request from accepted, new, partial, filled, canceled, rejected and expired order states

scenes.title: SUBMITTED IS NOT FILLED
scenes.narration: An order request is not proof of execution. Check the broker-reported status before you record a fill or update a position.

scenes.title: READ THE LIFECYCLE
scenes.narration: Alpaca defines accepted as an order received by the broker but not yet routed to an execution venue. New means it has been received and routed to exchanges for execution. Neither status means a fill has occurred. Status names are evidence, not decoration.

scenes.title: PARTIAL IS NOT COMPLETE
scenes.narration: A partially filled order has executed only in part. The remaining quantity is still outstanding. Keep the filled quantity separate from the unfilled balance, and check later updates before recording the order as complete. A fill record is evidence of execution, not a prediction.

scenes.title: CANCEL REQUESTS TAKE TIME
scenes.narration: Pending cancel means the order is waiting for cancellation. Canceled is a separate status. A cancel request can arrive after an order has already filled, so check the confirmed status rather than assuming the request succeeded. Do not mark an order closed while its status is still pending.

scenes.title: REJECTED OR EXPIRED?
scenes.narration: A rejected order has been rejected and receives no further updates. An expired order has reached the end of its time in force. Record those outcomes accurately; do not turn either into an executed trade. Keep the broker's time-in-force rules beside the status when you review the order.

scenes.title: LOG WHAT IS CONFIRMED
scenes.narration: In a paper simulation, preserve the sequence: submission, status changes, any partial execution, and final outcome. Report only the quantity the broker confirms as filled. Paper-trading education only; not live-money performance; not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.

claims.claim: accepted means an order has been received by Alpaca but has not yet been routed to the execution venue.
new means the order has been received by Alpaca and routed to exchanges for execution.
partially_filled means an order has been partially filled; filled means the order has been filled and no further updates will occur.
pending_cancel means the order is waiting to be canceled; canceled is a distinct completed status.
rejected and expired are distinct order statuses with no further updates.
an order may be canceled through the API until it reaches filled, canceled or expired.
